Subject: Group Office Hours — multi-prospect cadence & fallback roster

Hi Alex, Maya, Charlie —

Thanks for expressing interest in a shared office hours slot next week. We typically run a 45-min open office hours session for 2–4 prospects where we do a 20-min product walkthrough + 20-min Q&A and leave a few minutes for next steps. To make this low-friction for engineering teams, we try to keep the cadence tight and provide a clear fallback roster in case hosts need to swap.

Proposed primary slot: Tue, Aug 25, 2026 — 11:00–11:45 AM PDT
Fallback slots (if conflict): Tue Aug 25 — 2:00–2:45 PM PDT or Wed Aug 26 — 8:00–8:45 AM PDT

Would one of those work for your teams? If yes, please confirm headcount and any topics you want covered (inference latency targets, quantization guidance, VPC/private deploy checklist, etc.). I’m cc’ing Ben and Lauren to confirm hosts and bridge setup.

Agenda stub attached. Calendar invite will follow once we confirm a time.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: office-hours-agenda.pdf (1 page)
